name: guards
description: In-process port of the Planner-Worker shell guards: main-branch guard, plan Read-Write Scope guard with an Approve button (/approve <path>), kit-owned files, new-plan similarity, a hard deny on git push --no-verify, and the role line injected at start.

failOpen.title: Scope guard fails open
failOpen.description: When the scope check itself errors, allow the edit (the /ship scope gate still verifies). Off = deny.

hotspots.title: Append-only hotspots
hotspots.description: Comma-separated repo-relative files every plan may append to (never rewrite). Empty = the list the kit rendered into scripts/scope-check.mjs (paths.hotspots, project.i18nFile and the stack pack's defaults).
